commands.name: t27-check
commands.description: Parse and typecheck one .t27 spec with t27c. Use after a spec edit, before tests.

commands.name: t27-seal
commands.description: Seal one spec with t27c seal --save and --verify. Use after that spec's tests pass.

commands.name: t27-test
commands.description: Run one spec's tests with t27b and t27c test-report. Use when behavior must be shown.

skills.name: t27
skills.description: Work in a t27 checkout. Use when the tree has specs or the user names t27, t27c, t27b, or t27.ai.
